title: ID0454652-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / RN 313405951012] Charger offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue -
Charger offline
Solution: verification of the following items: correct insertion of sim card, verify stability of network connection, reset of router via system or factory reset. If none of these trouble shooting steps solve the issue replace of the router.

additional_info.subject: Case description
additional_info.body:
The charger has power supply; however, it appears offline both in the mobile application and on the Siemens portal. In addition, the sockets are not visible on the charger display, and charging sessions cannot be initiated.
Power supply is available at the site.
The charger display is active, but no sockets are shown.
The unit appears offline on both the backend portal and the mobile application.
Kindly investigate the issue and advise on corrective actions or next steps.
Thank you,

Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case

﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.

Y2 / RN 313405951012)
Charger ID / Serial No.:
QbdO93
Problem Description
: Charger offline
Possible solution:
Please proceed with a technician athe facilities of the customer :
The client has informed us that the charger is currently offline from SCB. After verification, we have confirmed this issue.
Please perform the following checks:
Ensure the SIM card is correctly inserted.
Verify that the network connection is stable.
Before requesting a router replacement, please try the following:
First, attempt to reset the router to its default settings via the
System
tab in the router interface.
If that does not resolve the issue, perform a
factory reset
using the button located on the back of the router.
If the issue persists after these steps, proceed with replacing the router.
We will provide you with all necessary details for the required router model for this charger:
8EM5903-0AA05-7AA5 – Router Ethernet Mobile (4G) RUT241
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,

Philippe Joaquim Ribeiro
